name: Sibbecai
overview: Sibbecai was a male warrior from the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the Hushathite of the Zerahites. He is noted in Scripture as a descendant of Zerah and held a leadership role over the eighth division of the army. His designation as a Zerahite highlights his lineage within the tribe of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Sibbecai is recorded without a specified meaning. Additionally, the name Mebunnai, meaning "well built," is associated with the same textual context but is a distinct individual. There are no divine attributions or special titles connected to these names beyond their proper name status.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Sibbecai as a descendant of Zerah, linking him to a particular family line within Judah. No other family relationships are documented beyond this genealogy.
scriptureSignificance: Sibbecai's significance lies in his military leadership within the tribe of Judah, specifically as a commander over the eighth division, which underscores his role in the organization of David's army. His identification as the Hushathite of the Zerahites connects him to a notable clan, emphasizing the tribal structure and heritage important in the biblical narrative. His mention in the context of military exploits reflects the faithfulness and valor expected of God’s people in defending the nation.
